title: Bolt.new Review 2026: Features, Pricing, Limits & Alternatives

facts.fact: The page states that Bolt.new is free to start, with paid plans starting at $25 per month.
facts.quote: free to start, with paid plans from $25 per month

facts.fact: According to the page's pricing table, Bolt.new's Free plan costs $0.
According to the page's pricing table, the Pro plan starts at $25 per month.
facts.quote: Pro | From $25 per month | From 10M per month, no daily cap

facts.fact: According to the page's pricing table, the Teams plan costs $30 per member per month, with tokens counted per member rather than pooled.
facts.quote: Teams | $30 per member per month | Per member, not pooled

facts.fact: According to the page, the Free plan includes 1M tokens per month and 300K tokens per day.
According to the page, the Pro plan includes from 10M tokens per month with no daily cap.
facts.quote: From 10M per month, no daily cap

facts.fact: According to the page, the Free plan allows uploads of up to 10 MB and includes Bolt branding.
facts.quote: Bolt branding, 10 MB uploads, limited hosting

facts.fact: According to the page, the Pro plan includes custom domains, removes Bolt branding, allows larger uploads, and offers token rollover.
facts.quote: Custom domains, no Bolt branding, larger uploads, token rollover

facts.fact: According to the page, the Enterprise plan is priced and tokenized on a custom basis, with the vendor contact required.
The page states that Bolt.new charges by tokens consumed as the AI reads and writes code, not by seats or prompts.
facts.quote: Bolt.new charges by tokens, which are consumed as the AI reads and writes code, not by seats or prompts.

facts.fact: The page states that Bolt does not publish how many tokens a typical prompt uses.
facts.quote: Bolt does not publish how many tokens a typical prompt uses

facts.fact: The page states that higher Pro tiers with larger token allowances also exist, without giving their prices.
facts.quote: Higher Pro tiers with larger token allowances also exist.

facts.fact: According to the page, Bolt.new is built on StackBlitz's WebContainers and runs in the browser with no local setup.
facts.quote: Bolt.new is an AI-powered, browser-based app builder from StackBlitz.

facts.fact: The page states that Bolt.new can target iOS and Android mobile apps through Expo (React Native).
facts.quote: Bolt uses Expo (React Native) to target iOS and Android from one codebase.

facts.fact: The page states that a first working prototype typically takes minutes in Bolt.new, though refining it takes longer.
facts.quote: a first working prototype typically takes minutes, though refining it takes longer

facts.fact: The page lists React, Vue, Next.js, Astro, Svelte, and Remix among the frameworks Bolt.new works with.
facts.quote: Works with popular frameworks such as React, Vue, Next.js, Astro, Svelte, and Remix
